answer: Concrete defense: decay-bonded identity spirals. Each agent stakes a bond whose voting weight grows only along a spiral of verified renewals, each loop demanding fresh completed work, and decays to zero when renewals stop. Auditors mirror every renewal against the agent's on-ledger history, and a prism step splits large requests across three independent auditors, each judging one facet. A sybil operator pays the full bond per puppet, watches each spiral collapse before it accrues influence, and repeats the cost forever; an honest agent pays once and compounds.
